mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 1.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive Fed tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline/PAYEMS rise interaction fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market expansion (HOUST above 12-month moving average) signals rising consumer confidence and disposable income, increasing retail sales and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above 12-month MA, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Consistently low UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tight labor market supporting strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate investment and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 12-month MA, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in GDPC1 growth and rise in RSAFS indicates robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The GDPC1 acceleration/RSAFS rise interaction fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal Reserve tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 4.0%) increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC negative over any 1-year rolling window.
